query: Consider Media News Group, Inc.'s Non-Disclosure Agreement; Does the document allow the Receiving Party to independently develop information that is similar to the Confidential Information?
gold:
7. For purposes of this Agreement, “Confidential Information” shall not include any information which
(c) was independently developed by Recipient without reference to the Confidential Information disclosed to it pursuant hereto, or
rag_answer: Yes. Under Section 7(c) of the agreement, “Confidential Information” does not include information that was independently developed by the Recipient without reference to the Confidential Information disclosed under the agreement. Therefore, the Receiving Party may independently develop similar information, provided it does not reference or use the Confidential Information.

judge.gold_summary: 协议第7条规定，“保密信息”不包括接收方在未参考根据本协议向其披露的保密信息的情况下独立开发的信息。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答称根据第7(c)条，保密信息不包括接收方在未参考协议下披露的保密信息的情况下独立开发的信息，因此接收方可以独立开发类似信息，只要不参考或使用保密信息。
judge.reason: 系统回答覆盖了金标的关键要点：独立开发且未参考披露的保密信息不属于保密信息，并据此回应了是否允许独立开发类似信息，未与金标矛盾。
